what_this_is: One recorded decision for every item 8.01 filed in the seven E01 windows that deliver a value: whether the item reports a merger, acquisition or business combination that the registrant or one of its subsidiaries is party to - announced, agreed or completed. Made by reading each item whole (read_e01_eight_o_ones.py prints it), not from the alias hits, so an 8.01 reporting a transaction without an alias would be visible here too; none does.
